title: Pod Salt Core Blackjack 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pod Salt Core Blackjack delivers the bold, unmistakable flavour of classic aniseed with a subtly sweet finish and a crisp menthol twist. Inspired by the familiar confectionery, this distinctive vape offers a sharp liquorice kick mellowed by cool undertones, creating a flavour profile that’s both nostalgic and refreshingly clean. Formulated with nicotine salts for a smoother inhale and faster nicotine delivery, this e-liquid is ideal for vapers seeking a satisfying flavour with a more tactile throat hit. Blended at a balanced 50VG/50PG ratio, Pod Salt Core Blackjack works best with MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod systems, vape pens and starter kits. Available in 5mg, 11mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pod Salt Core Nic Salts are crafted in the UK to deliver consistent, high-quality performance and a wide choice of familiar yet creative flavours.
